experiment_scope: Local-only personal speech-pattern profile extraction from synthetic fixtures now and private redacted transcripts later.

synthetic_samples.text: So what I mean is, I don't want the answer to sound too perfect. I think it should breathe a little, pause sometimes, and then continue in a way that feels natural.
Okay, let me rephrase that. I am trying to say that the agent shouldn't copy a script; it should sound like it is actually thinking through the answer.
Also, ich meine, die Stimme soll nicht zu perfekt klingen. Manchmal gibt es eine kurze Pause, und dann geht es natuerlich weiter.
My name is Example Person and my phone number is 5550100. So, I mean, this private detail should never appear in an exported speech profile.
